english: Basta maps 25 November demonstrations and events across France against violence targeting women and gender minorities.

local.text: Basta recense les mobilisations du 25 novembre en France contre les violences visant les femmes et les minorités de genre.

english: In Memirlosho, Kenya, women are pooling savings and organising together to support their households and community. WoMin reports on how their savings groups work.
Freedom News reports that a court halted sanctions against Autistici/Inventati, an Italian collective that provides independent digital infrastructure.
